title: LTB-CF2-PROBE-CONTAIN-001: fail-closed authority on ten draft probe emitters
intent: On base cf3f1c131fbee4586d82780b865eb1d09af8a350, the ten live probe JSON and draft-download routes consult the five existing probe tool ids before generation. Production stays HTTP 409 SAFETY_BLOCKED. No generator is qualified.
behavior_change: Ten probe routes change from live G-code emission to HTTP 409 SAFETY_BLOCKED before generation. The five download_governed routes keep their existing tool ids and event types.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Each probe family keeps one tool id. JSON uses event type {tool_id}_json and historical download uses {tool_id}_download. download_governed keeps its current event type. Permitted JSON responses keep ProbeOut and add governed headers. Permitted downloads use the existing governed attachment helper.
diff_articulation.why: LTB-CF2-INVENTORY-001 found these ten routes emitting machine instructions with no authority call.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: P-3 gated only the five download_governed routes and left the JSON and draft-download siblings emitting. This order contains those siblings without a new tool id or evaluator.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: No generator, geometry, or G-code text changed. No engine or resolve_mode was added. Polygon, geometry, rosette, and the other live-ungoverned families are untouched. No physical machine executes a program. Issue 401 stays open.
diff_articulation.why_structural_extraction: persist_authorized_probe_program delegates to the existing persist helper so the JSON carrier records the same decision the download carrier already records.

commands_run: Branch cursor/cf2-probe-draft-containment-46e5 was cut from origin/main cf3f1c131fbee4586d82780b865eb1d09af8a350.

cd services/api && python3 -m pytest tests/rmos/test_cf2_probe_output_containment.py tests/rmos/test_p3_governed_route_inventory.py tests/rmos/test_p3_governed_route_refusals.py tests/test_probe_router.py tests/test_manufacturing_output_inventory.py tests/test_manufacturing_output_inventory_rows.py -q --no-cov -> 126 passed.

cd services/api && python3 -m app.ci.check_file_sizes --baseline app/ci/file_sizes_baseline.json && python3 -m app.ci.check_complexity --baseline app/ci/complexity_baseline.json && python3 -m app.ci.check_bare_except && python3 -m app.ci.check_duplication --threshold 100 && python3 -m app.ci.fence_checker_v2 && python3 -m app.ci.check_execution_class_compliance
proofs: Fifteen probe-output routes share the five existing tool ids. The ten new carriers refuse before generate_* with HTTP 409, lane governed, a run id, and no program hash.
A non-autouse fixture permits only those five tool ids. JSON keeps ProbeOut and persists that decision. Download returns a governed attachment. Other tool ids stay blocked.
Inventory moves exactly those ten rows to FAIL_CLOSED. Candidates stay 239. Fail-closed 25 to 35. Live-ungoverned 25 to 15. Polygon and geometry drafts stay live-ungoverned.
verification.hardware: No physical-machine execution. No generated program was sent to a machine.
